title: Mat Davin
html_source: Maurice Davin (1864-1927), athlete and cofounder with Michael Cusack of the Gaelic Athletic Association. During the 1870s he and his brothers, Tom and Pat, held more than half the world’s records for running, jumping, hurdling and weight-throwing.
